column3: BSB adds “all sorts of” and renders “hateful” as “being hated.”
BSB moves “He saved us” to the front and renders “regeneration” as “new birth.”
BSB renders “nothing may be lacking to them” as “they will have everything they need.”
BSB follows the critical text without “Amen”; the Textus Receptus adds “Amen” and a closing note about writing from Nicopolis.
